_instructions: Copy this file to config/config.json and replace every value below. Then run: python code/01_cohort_and_definitions.py

_notes.timezone: the local timezone your CLIF datetimes are in, e.g. US/Central
_notes.project_root: the folder this repository is in
_notes.hospital_ids: every hospital_id that appears in clif_adt for your decedents, written exactly as it appears there. 01_cohort_and_definitions.py stops if the cohort contains an id not listed here, or if a listed id contributes no decedents.
